description: Simulates flash-loan drain vectors, oracle slot0/reserve exposure, and live on-chain TVL across five EVM chains for a target protocol (protocolName required; poolAddress defaults to Base Aerodrome address when omitted, tvlUsd defaults to 250000). Strictly read-only: reads live RPC liquidity and optional Solidity code to compute exploitImmunityScore and unsigned EIP-5792/EOA Safe-Harbor rescue calldata (90%-95% to optional ownerTreasury, 5%-10% whitehat bounty on rescue only) without transferring funds. Set tier to FULL ($45.00 USDC, default) for flashLoanSimulation and rescue bundle or ESSENTIAL ($9.50 USDC) for vulnerabilitySeverity and score; unpaid calls return isError: true and CRITICAL/HIGH PoCs stay sealed under Anti-Bypass. Use for live pool exploitability and rescue planning; use ingravity_generateMultiContractProtocolDossier for multi-file codebase audits.

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID for live RPC bytecode and TVL verification (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

code.description: Optional Solidity (.sol) contract source code to include static exploit, honeypot, and slot0 manipulation analysis.

ownerTreasury.description: Optional protocol owner/multisig recipient (0x...) receiving 90%-95% of assets in the generated unsigned Safe-Harbor calldata.

poolAddress.description: Target 42-char EVM pool or vault contract address (0x...) inspected via live RPC on chainId.

protocolName.description: Target protocol or pool identifier (non-empty string required).

tvlUsd.description: Declared pool TVL in USD; automatically overridden upward if live on-chain RPC TVL exceeds it.
